blockingFindings.title: R3 test encodes the old task-gate prompt premise
blockingFindings.issue: The test expects task-gate to keep instructionsKey "impl.impl-gate" and does not require src/flow/prompts/task/task-gate.md. R3 requires instructionsKey values and prompt filenames to move to the new step id while preserving the branch directory structure.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Assert that task-gate uses a task-scoped new prompt key/file, e.g. task.task-gate with prompts/task/task-gate.md, and assert the old task gate prompt filename is absent, unless the requirement is explicitly amended to allow shared impl prompts.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: As written, the tests would reject a requirement-compliant task prompt rename and allow the old cross-branch prompt premise to remain.

blockingFindings.title: R7 issue-log collision preservation is incomplete
blockingFindings.issue: The fixture verifies issue-log.json preserves only the gate-impl collision. It does not include or assert preservation of the other required collision ids, review and impl.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add issue-log.json fixture entries for step "review" and step "impl" and assert they remain unchanged after --apply.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: An implementation that incorrectly migrates issue-log review or impl would pass while violating R7's required collision handling.

blockingFindings.title: R5 authored prompt contents are not scanned
blockingFindings.issue: R5 requires old step names to be absent from authored sources including src code, skills, and prompts, but the R5 scan only checks src/skills plus installed skill copies. src/flow/prompts contents are skipped elsewhere and old step names inside renamed prompt files would pass.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Include src/flow/prompts markdown files in the old-step-id scan, or add a dedicated prompt-content grep test for the rename target ids.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: The requirement coverage artifact marks R5 covered, but a required grep target has no executable coverage.

advisoryFindings.title: R9 changelog precondition assertion is weak
advisoryFindings.improvement: Strengthen the CHANGELOG assertion from merely containing "active flow" to checking the stated merge precondition that there must be no other active flow.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The current test still covers the main breaking-change notice, migration tool reference, alias removal, and re-run guidance; this is a precision improvement for wording coverage.
